Hi, I’m Dr. Hoots. Here’s what to expect after your surgery site heals.
After the surgery site has healed, you return for your first programming visit.
At your first programming visit, a hearing specialist called an audiologist programs the speech processor you wear outside your ear. The program is made for your needs.
